import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw candidate input source/native/product graph and whole binary Git custody; no semantic or native promotion.')

def fixed_json(path):

def roots():

    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==

            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',

def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)

    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:

            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()

            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path

def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'complete fixed source blob')
            raw = process.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
            need(len(raw) == int(header[2]) and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole source blob body')

        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'', 'whole Git source protocol')

import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:

            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,

def fixed_json(path):

def roots():

    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))

def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():

    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==

            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())

import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

def roots():

    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)

    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],

            after = path.stat()

            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())

    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical fixed association prerequisite')

def nodes(raw):
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: |\Z)', raw, re.M | re.S))
    result = {m[1].decode(): m[0] for m in matches}
    need(len(result) == len(matches), 'complete unique association task identities')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1] if match else None

    original = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    declared = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / 'declared-task.md.gz').read_bytes())
    old, start = nodes(original), nodes(declared)
    need(set(old) == set(start), 'whole original association task population conserved at activation')
    for key in old:
        if key == LEAF:
            need(start[key] == old[key].replace(b'  Status: `pending`\n', b'  Status: `active`\n', 1)
                 and field(old[key], 'Status') == b'pending', 'sole association closure leaf activation')
        else:
            need(old[key] == start[key], 'every other original association contract conserved at activation')
    descendants = sorted(key for key in old if key.startswith(OWNER + '.'))
    need(field(old[OWNER], 'Status') == b'active' and LEAF in descendants
         and all(field(old[key], 'Status') == b'done' for key in descendants if key != LEAF),
         'all complete association construction, custody, semantic and repair descendants committed first')
    if final is not None:
        end = nodes(final)
        need(set(end) == set(old), 'whole original task graph conserved at association closure')
        for key in old:
            if key in (OWNER, LEAF):
                need(all(field(old[key], k) == field(start[key], k) == field(end[key], k) for k in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children'))
                     and field(end[key], 'Status') == b'done', 'original complete association acceptance closes unchanged')
            else:
                need(old[key] == end[key], 'every unrelated node and completed descendant conserves exactly')
    return dict(original=pin(original), declared=pin(declared), final=pin(final) if final is not None else None,
        contracts={key: dict(goal=field(old[key], 'Goal').decode(), acceptance=(field(old[key], 'Acceptance') or b'').decode(),
            children=(field(old[key], 'Children') or b'').decode(), status=field(old[key], 'Status').decode())
            for key in [OWNER, *descendants]})

         'actual clean committed association prerequisite checkpoint')

    for name in names:

def entries(selected):

    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):

         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')

    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)

            path = Path(directory)

            seen_dirs.add(str(path))

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==

            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',

    finally:

            process.kill()
            process.wait()

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path


def save(name, value):
    path = local(BASE / name, exists=False)

    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def load(name):

def save_product(name, value):

def product(name):

def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

def fixed_sources(names):
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    result = {}
    try:
        for name in sorted(names):
            need('\n' not in name and ':' not in name and not name.startswith('/'), 'safe complete Git source member')
            process.stdin.write((REVISION + ':' + name + '\n').encode())
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'complete fixed source blob')
            raw = process.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
            need(len(raw) == int(header[2]) and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole source blob body')
            result[name] = raw
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'', 'whole Git source protocol')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    return result


def metrics(sources):
    rows = {}
    for name, raw in sources.items():
        lines = raw.split(b'\n')
        widths = [len(line[:-1] if index < len(lines)-1 and line.endswith(b'\r') else line)
                  for index, line in enumerate(lines)]
        rows[name] = dict(**pin(raw), lines=raw.count(b'\n'), line_bytes=max(widths, default=0))
    return dict(members=rows, metrics=dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_total=sum(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), bytes_each=max(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_each=max(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), line_bytes_each=max(r['line_bytes'] for r in rows.values())))

import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()
    save('intake-after.json' if args.after else 'intake-before.json', result)
    if args.after:
        need(result == load('intake-before.json'), 'whole input source/native/product epoch conserved across every reader')
    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw candidate input source/native/product graph and whole binary Git custody; no semantic or native promotion.')

def roots():

def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))

    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')

def entries(selected):

    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)

        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,

         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')

    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)

            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:

def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)

    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:

            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()

            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path

def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw candidate input source/native/product graph and whole binary Git custody; no semantic or native promotion.')

def read(path):

def nodes(raw):
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: |\Z)', raw, re.M | re.S))
    result = {m[1].decode(): m[0] for m in matches}
    need(len(result) == len(matches), 'complete unique association task identities')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1] if match else None


def contracts(final=None):
    original = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    declared = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / 'declared-task.md.gz').read_bytes())
    old, start = nodes(original), nodes(declared)
    need(set(old) == set(start), 'whole original association task population conserved at activation')
    for key in old:
        if key == LEAF:
            need(start[key] == old[key].replace(b'  Status: `pending`\n', b'  Status: `active`\n', 1)
                 and field(old[key], 'Status') == b'pending', 'sole association closure leaf activation')
        else:
            need(old[key] == start[key], 'every other original association contract conserved at activation')
    descendants = sorted(key for key in old if key.startswith(OWNER + '.'))
    need(field(old[OWNER], 'Status') == b'active' and LEAF in descendants
         and all(field(old[key], 'Status') == b'done' for key in descendants if key != LEAF),
         'all complete association construction, custody, semantic and repair descendants committed first')
    if final is not None:
        end = nodes(final)
        need(set(end) == set(old), 'whole original task graph conserved at association closure')
        for key in old:
            if key in (OWNER, LEAF):
                need(all(field(old[key], k) == field(start[key], k) == field(end[key], k) for k in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children'))
                     and field(end[key], 'Status') == b'done', 'original complete association acceptance closes unchanged')
            else:
                need(old[key] == end[key], 'every unrelated node and completed descendant conserves exactly')
    return dict(original=pin(original), declared=pin(declared), final=pin(final) if final is not None else None,
        contracts={key: dict(goal=field(old[key], 'Goal').decode(), acceptance=(field(old[key], 'Acceptance') or b'').decode(),
            children=(field(old[key], 'Children') or b'').decode(), status=field(old[key], 'Status').decode())

         'actual clean committed association prerequisite checkpoint')

    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name in names:
        with local(name).open('rb') as stream:
            while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
                digest.update(chunk)
    need(type(row['members']) is int and row['members'] == len(names)
         and type(row['bytes']) is int and row['bytes'] == sum(source['members'][name]['bytes'] for name in names)
         and row['ordered_complete_bytes_sha256'] == digest.hexdigest()

def fixed_json(path):

def roots():

    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:

            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()

            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:

            process.kill()
            process.wait()

        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

    result = {}

    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)

            path = Path(directory)

            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:

def need(condition, message):

def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path

def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==

            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',

def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, PRIOR)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size

                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:

            process.kill()
            process.wait()

    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,

        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

    return directories

    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()

def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)

    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:

            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()

            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')

                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==

            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',

    matches = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: |\Z)', raw, re.M | re.S))
    result = {m[1].decode(): m[0] for m in matches}
    need(len(result) == len(matches), 'complete unique association task identities')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1] if match else None


def contracts(final=None):
    original = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    declared = gzip.decompress(local(BASE / 'declared-task.md.gz').read_bytes())
    old, start = nodes(original), nodes(declared)
    need(set(old) == set(start), 'whole original association task population conserved at activation')
    for key in old:
        if key == LEAF:
            need(start[key] == old[key].replace(b'  Status: `pending`\n', b'  Status: `active`\n', 1)
                 and field(old[key], 'Status') == b'pending', 'sole association closure leaf activation')
        else:
            need(old[key] == start[key], 'every other original association contract conserved at activation')
    descendants = sorted(key for key in old if key.startswith(OWNER + '.'))
    need(field(old[OWNER], 'Status') == b'active' and LEAF in descendants
         and all(field(old[key], 'Status') == b'done' for key in descendants if key != LEAF),
         'all complete association construction, custody, semantic and repair descendants committed first')
    if final is not None:
        end = nodes(final)
        need(set(end) == set(old), 'whole original task graph conserved at association closure')
        for key in old:

                     and field(end[key], 'Status') == b'done', 'original complete association acceptance closes unchanged')
            else:
                need(old[key] == end[key], 'every unrelated node and completed descendant conserves exactly')
    return dict(original=pin(original), declared=pin(declared), final=pin(final) if final is not None else None,
        contracts={key: dict(goal=field(old[key], 'Goal').decode(), acceptance=(field(old[key], 'Acceptance') or b'').decode(),
            children=(field(old[key], 'Children') or b'').decode(), status=field(old[key], 'Status').decode())
            for key in [OWNER, *descendants]})
